breakdown.description: The torque-induced arc load is replaced by a fixed global-x traction instead of a tangential traction field
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies a tangential traction to the loaded arc, stating 'The traction vector at each point on the arc is oriented tangentially to the arc.' This aligns with the ground truth instruction to 'Apply the traction in the local tangent direction of the loaded arc or curve; do not replace it by a fixed global x or y vector.' The incomplete prompt's error of using a fixed Cartesian vector (M/(2*pi*r), 0) has been corrected.
